description: Sanctions screening only, cheapest tier: is this company on an official sanctions list? One call checks the US Consolidated Screening List (incl. OFAC SDN), the UK Sanctions List, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the Consolidated Canadian Autonomous Sanctions List (UN designations included as implemented by the UK and the EU), each refreshed daily. Returns a clear action (allow / review / block), a 0-100 risk score, matches with the official list references and the date of each list copy. Companies only. Every response includes an Ed25519-signed receipt, verifiable with the public key at /.well-known/tolca-receipt-key.json. Keep it as proof of the check if a payment is ever disputed. Input: name, optional country. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/sanctions-check with an x402 client.
